Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses GOVERNMENT OF INDIA DEPARTMENT OF SPACE INDIAN SPACE RESEARCH ORGANISATION, HEADQUARTERS BENGALURU – 560 094 Request for Proposal - Work Package for Administrative Support Services for the Peri od of 24 Months. GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR SERVICE CONTRACT 1. DEFINITIONS: 1.1. The term ‘Service receiver’ shall mean “Indian Space Research Organisation Headqua rters”, Antariksh Bhavan, New BEL Road, Bangalore – 560 094, hereinafter referred as IS RO HQ. 1.2. The term ‘Focal Point’ shall mean the designated officials of Service Receiver, who will be coordinating with the Supervisor of the Service Provider. 1.3. The term ‘Service Provider’ shall mean the vendor to whom the contract has been aw arded against this tender. 1.4. The term ‘Supervisor’ shall mean an identified person of the ‘Service Provider’, who wil l supervise the work carried out by the qualified work-force of ‘Service Provider’. 1.5. The term ‘Workforce’ shall mean all the employees, supervisors and staff of the Servic e Provider deployed by the Service Provider to carry out the Work Package tasks as defin

ed in the Work Package Order. 1.6. The term ‘Contract’ refers to Work Package Contract for engagement of Administrative Support Services for DOS/ISRO HQ as per the Terms & Conditions of the contract. 1.7. The term ‘TSU’ shall mean two hours of administrative support services rendered by a workforce of the Service Provider. 1.8. The term ‘Paying Authority’ shall mean the respective Sr. Accounts Officer/ Accounts O fficer of the Service Receiver. 2. SCOPE OF WORK: 2.1 To provide Administrative Support Services for Administrative work in various Section/ Di visions of DOS/ISRO HQ, Antariksh Bhavan. The nature of work required are given below: a) Administrative Support services at DOS/ISRO HQ. b) To carryout various other jobs such as MS Office, Database, AutoCAD, etc. c) Organizing documents by printing reports, arranging printouts, taking photocopies, collecting, arranging, circulating etc. d) Carrying out help desk functions, scanning, editing data etc. communication throug h email, Telephone, Fax etc. e) Collection of literature through browsing of Internet, etc. f) Any other work assigned by respective offices. 2.2 The quantum of work under each one of the above activities will vary from section to s ection as well as activity to activity. Based on the earlier experience, it is estimated that t he quantum of work to be carried out will call for about 60 workforces. However, dependi ng on the workload, the number of workforces required may vary from time to time. How ever, the service provider shall deploy as many numbers of workforce as directed by the f ocal point to render the services depending on the requirements. ISRO HQ reserves the ri ght to reduce or increase the Work force at any point of time within the validity of the con tract without furnishing any reason whatsoever. 2.3 The normal working hours of office shall be 09:30 Hours to 18:00 Hours from Monday t o Friday with lunch break of 30 minutes. The services are required on all working days an d depending on need, beyond office hours and / or on Saturdays/ Sundays/ Public Holiday s. The Service Provider shall strictly adhere and ensure that workforce and supervisor av ailed minimum one day weekly-off. In any cases, no. of working days shall not exceed 6 d ays in a week. 2.4 Administrative Support Service activities carried out in Two hours is defined as One ‘TS U’. In general cases, TSU per workforce will be 4 per day. In official exigencies, depending upon the requirements from ISRO/ DOS, service per workforce per day may increase beyo nd 4. However, the service provider shall strictly ensure that maximum allowable TSU per day per workforce shall be restricted to 6. The number of TSUs and Workforce are as mentioned below. The quantity below is indicat ive only. DOS/ISRO reserves the right to increase / decrease the daily requirement workfo rce / service from time to time. Total quantu Sl. Likely number of wor Nature of Servi m of work No kforce to be deployed ces (TSU for 02 y . daily ears) Administrative Su 1. 60 187200 pport Services 2.5 In case the service provider fails to deploy the required minimum number of workforce within 1 hour of beginning of the office hours on more than 02 occasions in a month servic e provider shall be liable for deduction of amount corresponding to of 4 x ‘N’ TSUs from hi s bill on each occasion (‘N’ is the number of personnel service provider could not deploy w ithin one hour of beginning of office hours). For calculating the above work load, every Tw o Hours of service rendered will be treated as one unit of service. 2.6 The service provider shall maintain a register for the execution of the work and get end orsement of the same from the focal point of ISRO HQ every day for having completed the

work satisfactorily. Only works shall be recorded in this register with appropriate ‘TSU’. N o details of the workforce to be mentioned here. Service provider shall keep a separate re gister under their custody for logging the details of works performed by their individual w orkforce. The internal register of the service provider shall not be endorsed by Focal point / representative of ISRO / DOS. 3. QUALIFICATION OF THE WORKFORCE: 3.1 The service provider shall provide the Administrative Support Services through the work force with the following qualifications. a. Diploma in Commercial Practice with good Communication skills. OR b. Graduate (3 years) in any branch of Science/ Arts/ Commerce. Conversant with the working of computers and necessarily have knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel and MS Power Point packages. c. English Typing knowledge is necessary. d. The Age should not be less than 18 years and not more than 35 years. 3.2 Bio-data and two stamp size photographs of the workforce planned to be deployed shou ld be provided before their deployment. 3.3 The character and Antecedents of the workforce to be deployed shall be verified throug h the Police authorities concerned, and submit the original Police verification report to ISR O HQ before their deployment. 3.4 Antariksh Bhavan being a high security area, the Service Provider, will be required to fo llow the security requirements for his workforce such as possessing a valid Identity Card i ssued by the service provider while entering the campus and maintain high order of disci pline while on work. 3.5 The service provider or his workforce shall not misuse the premises allotted to them for any purpose other than for which the contract is awarded. 3.6 If any of the workforce is found unacceptable for any reason, the Service provider shall be required to substitute the same by another suitable workforce within a reasonable tim e. 3.7 The workforce engaged shall attend for duties by making their own transport arrangem ent and DOS/ ISRO shall not pay any conveyance charges. 3.8. The workforce deployed shall reach the work spot well in time and strictly follow the rul es and regulations regarding safety and security of DOS/ ISRO. 3.9 The workforce deployed are not authorized to communicate any official’s information th ey may come across during and after their working period in DOS/ ISRO. 4. Period of Contract: 4.1 The contract shall initially be on trial for a period of 03 Months and on satisfactory completio n of the trial period, the contract may be confirmed and extended for a further period of 21 m onths, thus totally for a period of Two years from the date of award of contract, unless it is cur tailed or terminated by DOS/ISRO HQ, owing to deficiency of service, sub-standard quality of workforce deployed, breach of contract, reduction of cessation of the job requirements etc. Depending upon the need of ISRO/ DOS, in official exigencies, the contract may be extended for a further period upto one year which shall be mutually agreed upon by both the parties o n the same terms and conditions. In case of extension of contract beyond two years, service c harges per TSU will be at the same rate of percentage to the preceding year. 4.2 The timely payment of Employer’s and Employee’s contribution toward EPF & ESI at schedul ed rates shall be the sole responsibility of the Service Provider. The Service Provider shall be r esponsible for the payment of wages and allowance of his deployed work force as per minimu m wages in force fixed by the Central Govt./ State Govt. whichever is higher and all statutory dues (PF, ESI, etc.) to the workforce engaged by him for providing the manpower service. DOS

/ISRO shall in no way be responsible for any default with regard to any statutory obligation rel ated to the manpower deputed by the Service Provider. The workforce deployed by the servic e provider whose total remuneration is above Rs.21,000/- per month, the ESI act, 1948 is not applicable. Such work force shall be covered by a Mediclaim policy from Nationalized Insuranc e company with a coverage of Rs. 2 Lakh per annum/per person to the workforce at the cost-o f-service provider. The service provider has to arrange for insurance at their cost. 4.3 The Service Provider shall not be allowed to transfer, assign, pledge or sub-contract its right and liabilities under this contract to any other agency without the prior written consent of DO S/ ISRO. 5. Responsibilities of the selected Service Provider: 5.1. The Service Provider shall ensure deploying workforce who are capable of performing the na ture of work as prescribed under Scope of Contract. 5.2. The Character and Antecedents of the selected workforce shall be verified through record c heck by the Service Provider from the concerned Police authorities at their own cost, and the original Police Report shall be submitted to this office at the time of joining. 5.3 The Service Provider shall maintain his own Attendance Register and the workforce reportin g for work shall sign the attendance register duly indicating arrival and departure time regula rly and a certified copy (by the service provider) of the same shall be submitted along with his bills while claiming monthly payment. 5.4 The service provider should ensure deployment of workforce in total. In case of any absence , an alternate workforce who qualifies our requirement should be deployed by the service pro vider under intimation to this office. Whenever there is a need to provide a replacement due t o leave, etc., the details of substitute candidate should also have to be verified. For this purpo se, the service provider may keep a panel of workforces whose details have been verified. Ch anging of the workforce deployed should be intimated to the focal point in advance 5.5 The service provider shall identify a supervisor among the deployed workforce, who would b e responsible for immediate interaction with DOS/ISRO HQ so that optimal services of the wor kforce deployed by them could be avail without any disruption. 5.6 The service provider will be totally responsible for the duty and behavior of the workforce pr ovided by them. 5.7 The service provider shall provide his First Aid kit at the Identified place in Antariksh Bhavan for the use of their workforce. 5.8. DOS/ ISRO premises being High Security zone, the workforce deployed by the Service Provid er shall be required to follow the security requirements such as possessing a valid pass/ID ca rd while entering the campus, maintaining high order of discipline while on duty etc. the Serv ice provider shall issue a valid photo ID card to the personnel deployed. In case any Access C ontrol Identity card is issued by DOS/ ISRO to the workforce deployed by the service Provider and if any expenditure is involved, it has to be borne by the Service Provider. 5.9. In case, the workforce employed by the Service Provider commits any act of omission/ Com mission that amounts to misconduct/ indiscipline/ incompetence, the Service Provider shall int imate the same to DOS/ ISRO & be liable to take appropriate disciplinary action against such workforce including their removal from site of work, if required by DOS/ISRO. 5.10 The Service Provider shall replace any of its workforce who is found unacceptable to DOS/ IS RO because of security risks, incompetence, conflict of interest, improper conduct or for any other reasons, immediately upon receiving written notice from DOS/ ISRO. 5.11. The Service Provider shall provide a substitute workforce well in advance if there occurs prob ability of the workforce quitting the job due to his/her own personal reasons. The payments in respect of the overlapping period of the substitute shall be the responsibility of the Service Pr ovider. 5.12. In case of termination of the Work Package Order(s) on its expiry or otherwise, the work-force engaged by the Service Provider shall not be entitled to and shall have no claim whatsoever for any kind of employment in Service Receiver’s establishment and shall be made known by

the Service Provider to their workforce before being engaged. 5.13. The status of the Service Provider shall be that of an independent Service Provider. The Se rvice Provider and its work-force performing under this Work Package shall not be the employ ees of Service Receiver. Neither the Service Provider nor its work-force shall be considered a s employees of Service Receiver. Such work-force has no right for subsequent regularization. 5.14. The requirement of the quantity mentioned in the Work Package may vary (increase/decrease) and is subject to change based on actual requirement of the Service Rece iver. The Service Provider has also to complete any additional or sporadic requirement as req uired by the Service Receiver by engaging additional work-force, if any required. The payme nt will be based on the quantum of work completed which should be duly certified by the auth orized official of the Service Receiver. 5.15. The Service Provider should have their liaison office at Bengaluru throughout the period of co ntract for better coordination. Liaison office at Bengaluru is one of the mandatory req uirements of the contract. 6. Uniform: Gents : Black Pants, Pista Green Shirt , Black Shoe & Socks. Ladies: Black Pants, Black Dupatta, Pista Green Top, Black Shoe & Socks. The Service provider shall provide Stitched Uniforms, 2 sets per workforce per year (as indicat ed) to the concerned workforce. The Service Provider shall ensure that workforce engaged at S ervice Receiver’s Campus shall wear Uniform while they are on duty. Any instance of wearing alternative attire (other than prescribed uniform) by workforce shall incur a financial penalty of Rs. 100/- per workforce per day, payable by Service Provider. 7. Legal: 7.1 The Service Provider must be registered with the concerned Govt. Authorities, i.e. Central L abour Department, Provident Fund Authorities, Employees State Insurance Corporation, etc., and a copy of the registration certificate shall be submitted. 7.2 The Service Provider shall abide by the law of the land including, Contract Labour (Regulatio n & Abolition) Act 1970 and Contract Rules 1971, EPF Act, ESI Act, Minimum Wages Act, Equal Wages Act, Employees Compensation Act, Payment of Wages Act, Income Tax Act, Goods and Services Tax Act or any new regulations/legislations enacted in this regard and its complianc e as applicable during the tenure of the Contract Service Receiver shall in no way be responsi ble for any default regarding statutory obligation. The Service Provider has to ensure complia nce of the above provisions at the time of submission of bill to the Service Receiver and while making payments to their work-force at all times during the currency of the work package. 7.3 The Service Provider will discharge all the legal obligations in respect of the work-force enga ged by them for the execution of the work in respect of their wages and Service conditions an d shall also comply with all the rules and regulations and provisions of the law in force that m ay be applicable to them from time to time. The Service Provider shall indemnify and keep in demnified ISRO HQ from any claim, loss or damages that may be caused to it on account of a ny failure to comply with the obligations under various laws. In case of any dispute, the decisi on of ISRO HQ shall be final and binding on the Service Provider. 7.4 The timely payment of wage to the workforce, remittance of EPF and ESI (wherever applicabl e) shall be the sole responsibility of the Service Provider. For any default with regard to statut ory obligation, the Service Provider is solely responsible. Wherever workforce is not covered u nder ESI, Service Provider should provide Mediclaim Policy for a sum of Rs.2,00,000/- each to their Workforce per annum. The Original Mediclaim Policy should be with the workforce and a copy of the same shall be submitted to ISRO HQ. No separate reimbursement towards such M ediclaim policy will be made by ISRO HQ. 7.5 The Service Provider shall also be liable for the remittance of all Taxes, Levies, Cess etc., on

account of service rendered by them to the concerned authorities from time to time as per ex tant rules and regulations in the matter. 7.6 The Service Provider shall completely be responsible to maintain the Attendance, acquittanc e of wage paid, EPF and ESI or Comprehensive Mediclaim Policy as the case may be. Govern mental authorities shall have the right to inspect these records at any time and take necessar y penal action for non-compliance of these provisions, if any. 7.7 The Service Provider is fully responsible for timely claiming and disbursing monthly payment of wages to their workforce engaged in ISRO HQ, within the time limit prescribed in the releva nt Act/Rules. 7.8 Payment disbursement shall be made to the Service Provider by ISRO HQ on monthly basis f or the actual TSU completed and on receipt of the invoice/bill which is duly certified by the Fo cal Points and approved by concerned Divisional Head/Group Head in ISRO HQ and submitted to the Sr. Accounts Officer, ISRO HQ. 7.9 The Service Provider shall make the payment to the workforce by the 7th day of the succeedi ng month through the saving bank account of the respective workforce. The Service Provider should issue signed wage slip/statement on their letterhead to the work-force containing deta ils of wages paid, recoveries made etc. 7.10 The Service Provider shall engage the work-force as per the requirements sought for by the Service Receiver for which the Service Provider shall provide the bio-data along with the cred entials of the workforce. 7.11 Issue of Entry Pass: - For arranging Entry Pass to enter the Service Receiver's premises, the S ervice Provider should submit the details of the work force to the concerned Purchase & Store s Officer along with the following documents: (a) Police Verification Certificate: It is the responsibility of the Service Provider to arrange the character and antecedents of the work-force engaged for duty. The Service Provider shall engage the work-force who is not having any criminal background. The character and antece dents shall be verified through record check by Service Provider at their own cost from the c oncerned Police authorities (Police Verification Certificate) and submit the original report. Ge nerally, Police Verification Certificate is valid only for a period of 12 months/1 year. As and w hen the Police Verification Certificate expires, immediately a new Police Verification Certificate has to be provided and in the absence of the same, entry pass will be denied. (b) ID card issued by the Service Provider: The Service Provider shall issue necessary Id entity Card in their firm's logo to the work force deployed by them to ISRO HQ. (c) Copy of the AADHAR; (d) Copy of PAN Card (wherever applicable), and (e) Two copies of stamp size photographs: 7.12 In case, the Service Provider fails to comply with any statutory/ taxation liability under the a ppropriate law, and as a result, if ISRO HQ is put under any loss/obligation, monetary or other wise, ISRO HQ will be entitled to get itself reimbursed either out of the outstanding bills again st any of the Contract or from the Security Deposit to the extent of the loss or obligation in m onetary terms. 7.13 The Service Provider shall be bound by the details furnished by them to ISRO HQ while sub mitting the tender or at any subsequent stage(s). In case, any of the documents furnished by them is found to be false at any stage, it would be deemed to be a breach of the Terms and C onditions of the Work Package Contract making the Service Provider liable for legal action bes ides termination of Work Package Contract and forfeiture of Security Deposit. 7.14 The Service Provider shall not be allowed to transfer, pledge, assign or sub Contract its right s and liabilities under this Work Package Contract to any other agency. 7.15 The Service Provider shall be solely responsible for the redressal of grievances/resolution of

disputes relating to the work-force engaged by the Service Provider. Service Receiver shall in no way be responsible for the settlement of such disputes. Service Provider should maintain a record of grievances received from their work force and action taken for settlement and as an d when it is demanded by ISRO HQ, a copy of the same shall be provided. 7.16 For all intents and purposes, the Service Provider shall be the 'Employer within th e meaning of different Labour Legislations in respect of the work-force engaged b y the Service Provider/Bidder at ISRO HQ. The workforce engaged by the Service P rovider in ISRO HQ shall not have any claim whatsoever of "Master and Servant' rel ationship nor have any 'Principal and Agent' relationship with or against ISRO HQ f or the said services. The status of the Service Provider shall be that of an indepen dent Service Provider. The Service Provider and its work-force performing under th is Work Package Contract shall not be the employees of ISRO HQ. Neither the Servi ce Provider nor its work-force shall be considered as employees of ISRO HQ. Such work-force has no right for subsequent regularization. 7.17 The successful bidder upon being served with the Work package contract by the Service Rec eiver shall obtain all necessary Labour Licenses from the concerned Labour Department, Govt of India and the License shall be valid till the currency of the Work package contract. The For m III will be issued by the Principal Employer of ISRO HQ. 7.18 Any other terms, conditions or clauses not covered in this document shall be in accordance with all other statutory Rules / Acts applicable to DOS/ISRO HQ. 7.19 The Partners or Shareholders or Directors or Executives or Officers of the Service Provider sh all not engage themselves as workforce under the Work package. 7.20 In case of termination of Contract on its expiry or otherwise, the work-force engaged by the Service Provider shall not be entitled to and shall have no claim whatsoever for any kind of e mployment in ISRO HQ and shall be made known by the Service Provider to their workforce b efore being engaged. 7.21 The Service Provider shall not assign, transfer or convey in whole or in part, this Work/Servic e to anyone. The Service Provider may also not delegate any of its obligations or duties under this Service to anyone. The Service Provider may not assign, pledge as collateral, grant a sec urity interest in, create a lien against or otherwise encumber any payments that may or will b e made to the Service Provider under this Work Package. 7.22 The Service Provider shall be bound to accept all instructions/ directions issued by the Focal Point or any other person duly authorized by them relating to the execution of the Work Pack age. 7.23 The details of work handled by the work-force, Supervisor and Establishment should be kept secret and should not be divulged to any person or outside agencies. An undertaking in this r egard shall be provided by the Service Provider. 7.24 The Service Receiver reserves the right to reject any of the work-force engaged by the Servi ce Provider, if the presence or activity of such workforce is detrimental to the interest or disci pline or security of the Service Receiver. 7.25 The Service Provider is responsible to complete the quantum of work as specified in the Wor k Package and as required by the Service Receiver and in case of absence of the work-force, t he successful Service Provider should provide suitable replacement and for this purpose to en sure timely completion and the Service Provider shall keep a panel of work-force whose Chara cter and Antecedents are verified. 8.0 Financial and Payment: 8.1 The payment to the workforce deployed shall be as per rate quoted by the service provider i n price bid format and shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by the Ministry of Labo ur and Employment, Government of India/ Government of Karnataka or by ISRO HQ, from tim e to time, whichever is higher. The rate(s) mentioned in the Work Package Orders(s) shall be f irm and fixed during the currency of the Order/Contract.

8.2 The service charges mentioned in the Work Package Contract shall be firm and fixed during the currency of the Contract. TSU quoted by the bidder shall appropriately account minimum wages, fixed service charges and other charges. There shall be no change in the Service Char ges / Profit Margin payable to the Service Provider even in case of wage revision if any. 8.3 The Service Provider’s bill shall be submitted before 28th (Twenty eighth) of ever y month, which shall cover the works accomplished between 21st of preceding month to 20t h of current month, with due certifications to the respective Paying Authority. To facilitate this payment cycle, Service Provider shall submit the bill to the concerned focal point of the Servic e Receiver by 21-23rd of the month for certification. For the first payment, works completed fr om the date of commencement of the work to 20th day of the corresponding month shall be t aken as the reference. 8.4 Payment disbursement shall be made to the Service Provider by the Service Receiver on m onthly basis for the actual TSU completed and part thereof, on receipt of Invoice/Bill which is duly certified by the identified focal point and submitted to the paying authority together wit h the following documentary proof. The Invoice/Bill shall indicate separately: a. Wages paid to workforce deployed b. Employer's Contribution remitted towards EPF and ESI c. Service Charge to the Service Provider d. GST as applicable and e. Valid Labour Licence issued by Ministry of Labour and Employment. 8.5 The supporting documents that should be submitted by Service Provider along with Bill/Invoic e are: i. Proof of payment of wages having made to the workforce for the preceding mon th for which receipt is submitted. ii. Proof of remittance of both Employee's and Employers Contribution towards EP F, ESI or Medi-claim Policy, as the case may be, made for the month including the sta tements containing the names of the workforce deployed, Account Numbers, Contrib ution paid and iii. Proof of GST paid for the preceding month towards bill amount received from IS RO HQ. At the discretion of this office, ISRO HQ shall hold up a requisite portion/whole of the bill amo unt till such proof is furnished. 8.6 The Service Provider is fully responsible for timely claiming and disbursing monthly payment of remuneration to their work-force engaged in the campus of the Service Receiver, within the time limit prescribed in the relevant Act/Rules. 8.7 The Service Provider shall make payment to their workforce by 07th day of the su cceeding month and should issue signed wage slip/ statement on their letterhead to the wo rk-force containing details of remuneration paid, recoveries made etc. 8.8 In case, the Service Provider fails to make payment to the workforce deployed by 7th of the succeeding month as mentioned above and not remitted the amount related to ESI and EPF t o the concerned authorities, ISRO HQ reserves the right to make alternate arrangements for s uch payments and recover the amount so paid from the Service Provider either by deduction of any amount payable to the Service Provider under the work order/service contract or any o ther work order/service contract placed on the Service Provider by ISRO HQ/ISRO or as debt p ayable by the Service Provider or shall be adjusted against Security Deposit and no notice sh all be issued for such payment by ISRO HQ. 8.9 In case of breach of any conditions under the Contract, the Security Deposit shall liable to be forfeited by the Service Receiver. In addition, the Service Contract is also liable to be terminat ed and any amount due to the Service Provider against any other Contract from the Service R eceiver is also liable to be appropriated. 8.10 In case of partnership firm, 'power of attorney should be signed by one person on behalf of others. Any breach of these conditions by the Service Provider in relation to the Bidding Estab lishment or Partner or Shareholders or Directors or Executives or Office Bearers, the tender/ Work Package contract will be cancelled and earnest money/security deposit will be forfeited at any stage whenever it is so noticed. The Service Receiver will not pay any damages to the

Service Provider. The Service Provider will also be debarred from further participation in the c oncerned unit of the Service Receiver. 8.11 In case of a workforce deployed coming late or going early twice a week, wages for four unit s shall be deducted from the total wages payable. If the late coming or early going persists fo r a period exceeding 5 days consecutively, the services of the individual shall be discontinued by the Service Provider, and a suitable replacement be provided immediately. The identified " Focal Point" in ISRO HQ shall intimate to the Service Provider or his representative in this reg ard. 8.12 The Stitched Uniforms as per Para 6, 2 sets per workforce per year shall be issued to the con cerned workforce in the presence of Focal Point of ISRO HQ / representative. The service char ges payable will be inclusive of such stitched uniform cost. No additional reimbursement any other cost, if any shall be made by service receiver ISRO HQ. 8.13 Goods and Services Taxes - The total Contract value is inclusive of Goods & Service Tax. The present rate of Goods and Service Tax is 18%. Request to bill under B2C. In case of any reduc tion to GST rates, the same shall be recovered by ISRO HQ. Similarly, any increase in GST rat es, ISRO HQ shall reimburse against documentary proof. GST TDS @ 2% or as amended from time to time shall be effected from the bill towards Suppl y of Goods and Services. 8.14 Income Tax - The Income Tax at Source [TDS] shall be deducted as per provisions of Income Tax Act as from time to time. Sr. Accounts Officer, ISRO HQ will issue necessary IT certificate. Income Tax or any other Tax/Taxes/Fees/Cess/Levy as applicable and payable by the Service Provider as per rules will be recovered from the monthly bills payable to the Service Provider. 8.15 Service Provider shall make the payment to workforce deployed through ECS not later than 7t h of succeeding month, and submit necessary proof from their banker to ISRO HQ/DOS tow ards the payment made for preceding month along with Bill / Invoice and other documentar y proof. GeM Invoice to be raised by the Service Provider on monthly basis for en abling us to generate SDAC (Service Delivery Acceptance Certificate) and for pro cessing payment. Alternatively, the payment can also be made by cheque to the workfor ce deployed, in the presence of Contract Manager or his representative, before 4th of the s ucceeding month. 9.0 Parallel/Adhoc Contract: 9.1 DOS/ISRO HQ reserves the right to enter into parallel/ Adhoc contract(s) with one or more services provider(s) during the currency of the contract for availing the same or similar servi ces. 9.2 In order to identify more than one service provider, DOS/ISRO HQ reserves the right to aw ard the contract to any other service provider who has qualified in the subject tender and w illing to provide the services. 10. Focal point: Sr. Admin. Officer (GAD) (Ph: 080 2217 2293) or any authorized officer is identified as Foc al point for progress monitoring of the contract. 11. Security Deposit: The Service Provider shall guarantee faithful execution of the contract in accordance with terms and conditions specified herein. As a performance security, the Service Provider shou ld furnish a security deposit for 3% (Three percent) of the total contract value within 15 day s from the deployment in the form of Bank Guarantee/FDR/DD valid for entire Contract perio d with a claim period of sixty days beyond the validity of the Bank Guarantee. The SD shall not carry any interest and shall be returned after satisfactory completion of the contractual obligation. In the event of any breach of any of the terms and conditions of the contract, DOS/ISRO H Q shall have (without prejudice to other right and remedies) the right to terminate contract

forthwith and/ or to forfeit the entire or part of the amount of security deposit or any par the reof. 12. General: Labour Laws: The contractor has to abide by all labour laws of the appropriate local body applicable in that place where work executed. The contractor shall be responsible for all co mpensation payable to the workmen under Workmen Compensation Act or any other enact ment in force. 13.
